description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Day or week view per staff member, room or rental pool: bookings, classes, blocked time and free windows. Every entry in resources carries an id: pass it as resource_id here to see just that one, or to owner_block_time and owner_set_schedule to change it. Use it to see how a day or week looks; for requests waiting for an answer use owner_list_bookings.

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

date.description: First day to show, YYYY-MM-DD, in the business's time zone. Default today.

days.description: How many days from `date`, 1 to 7. Default 1.

resource_id.description: Show only this staff member, room or rental pool: an id from `resources` in an earlier answer. Default: all of them.

name: owner_get_schedule
title: Schedule
